audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Rapid footsteps thud rhythmically against a hard floor, accompanied by the distant, high-pitched wail of an emergency siren. The acoustics suggest a large indoor space. No dialogue or music is present at this moment, focusing entirely on the urgent foley effects. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads into a weak, breathy male voice whispering 'Gu... Gu Beichen...' with heavy vocal strain and a very slow speech rate. A low-frequency, tense synthesizer pad begins to drone in the background, creating a melodramatic atmosphere. (3) A sudden 'click' sound marks the man's clear, articulated response: 'Bushi.' His voice is steady and projected. He then says 'Shi Gu bingchuang' with a humorous, dry tone. The dramatic background synth continues to hum softly under the dialogue. (4) A high-pitched digital 'ping' sound effect triggers as the man stops speaking. This is immediately followed by a long, continuous high-frequency 'beeeep' resembling a hospital monitor flatlining. The scene's audio ends abruptly after this sustained electronic tone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a short-form comedy skit that subverts the 'Domineering CEO' trope common in internet literature. The video uses a pun on the name 'Gu Beichen' (a stereotypical CEO name) by changing it to 'Gu Bingchuang' (Gu Bed) while in a hospital setting, delivering a humorous anti-climax.
